title: Biotin-Labelling of Immunoprecipitated RNA
author: Steven Blue
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7z4hp8w
materials: Develop membrane as follows using the Chemiluminescent Nucleic Acid Detection Module kit (cat. no. 89880)
Immediately incubate lysates in a Thermomixer set to 37°C, shaking at 1200 rpm, for 5 min.
For each 4M cell lysate, aliquot 25 μL of species-specific Dynabeads (e.g. ThermoFisher catalog # 11203D, 11202D, or equivalent)
Without removing the FastAP mix, add 150 μL of the PNK mix to each sample and place back on Thermomixer, incubating at 37°C, 1200 rpm, for 20 min.

steps.title: Lyse cells in eCLIP buffer
steps.instruction: Lyse cells in cold eCLIP lysis buffer containing 5.5 µL protease inhibitor cocktail III per 1 mL lysis buffer; use 200 µL lysis buffer for each 4 × 10⁶ cells.

steps.title: Sonicate lysates
steps.instruction: Sonicate lysates on low setting for 5 min with a 30 s on/30 s off cycle.

steps.title: Prepare RNase I dilutions
steps.instruction: Make two RNase I dilutions in PBS: 1:25 (4 U/µL) and 1:3 (33.3 U/µL).

steps.title: Add RNase I to lysates
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of the 1:25 dilution to the first cross‑linked lysate (Standard RNase), 2 µL of the 1:3 dilution to the second cross‑linked lysate (High RNase), and 2 µL of the 1:25 dilution to the non‑cross‑linked lysate (Standard RNase).

steps.title: Add Turbo DNase
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL Turbo DNase to each 4 × 10⁶‑cell lysate.

steps.title: Clarify lysates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C and transfer the cleared lysate to washed magnetic beads.

steps.title: Wash beads (first Lysis Buffer)
steps.instruction: Wash the beads twice with 500 µL cold Lysis Buffer; then resuspend beads in 100 µL Lysis Buffer.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate RBP
steps.instruction: Add 2 µg RBP‑specific antibody to each tube and rotate at room temperature for 45 min.

steps.title: Wash beads (Lysis Buffer, keep cold)
steps.instruction: Wash beads twice with 500 µL cold Lysis Buffer and keep on ice until step 14.

steps.title: Wash beads (High Salt Buffer)
steps.instruction: Wash beads twice with 500 µL cold High‑Salt Wash Buffer.

steps.title: High‑Salt / Wash Buffer wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL cold High‑Salt Wash Buffer, mix, then add 500 µL cold Wash Buffer, magnetically separate, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Three Washes with Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Wash beads three times with 500 µL cold Wash Buffer, keep on ice after the final wash; briefly spin tubes and discard residual buffer.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in master mix
steps.instruction: In an RNase‑free 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, resuspend the beads in 26 µL of the master mix (as defined in the original protocol).

steps.title: Incubate biotin‑labeling reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples at 16 °C with gentle shaking for 2 h or overnight (recommended).

steps.title: Post‑reaction High‑Salt wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL cold High‑Salt Wash Buffer, mix, magnetically separate, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Three Washes with Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the beads three times with 500 µL cold Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Resuspend beads for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 20 µL Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Add denaturing mix
steps.instruction: Add 10.5 µL denaturing mix (7.5 µL 4X LDS buffer + 3 µL 1 M DTT) to each sample.

steps.title: Heat denature samples
steps.instruction: Incubate at 70 °C while mixing at 1200 rpm for 10 min.

steps.title: Cool samples on ice
steps.instruction: Place tubes on ice for more than 1 min.

steps.title: Load samples onto gel
steps.instruction: Magnetically separate the beads, load 15 µL of each sample onto an SDS‑PAGE gel, and reserve the remaining half at –20 °C as a backup.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE gel
steps.instruction: Run the gel at 150 V for 75 min.

steps.title: Transfer to nitrocellulose
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins to a nitrocellulose membrane at 30 V overnight.

steps.title: Warm buffers
steps.instruction: Warm Blocking Buffer and 4X Wash Buffer in a water bath to 37–50 °C until all particulates dissolve.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL Blocking Buffer to the membrane and incubate 15 min with gentle shaking at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare streptavidin‑HRP solution
steps.instruction: Add 31.25 µL Stabilized Streptavidin‑Horseradish Peroxidase Conjugate to 10 mL Blocking Buffer.

steps.title: Incubate membrane with conjugate
steps.instruction: Decant the blocking buffer from the membrane, add 10 mL of the conjugate solution, and incubate the membrane for 15 min with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Prepare 1X wash solution
steps.instruction: Mix 40 mL 4X Wash Buffer with 120 mL water to obtain 1X Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Rinse membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer the membrane to a new container and rinse briefly with 20 mL 1X Wash Solution.

steps.title: Wash membrane four times
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane four times, 5 min each, in 20 mL 1X Wash Solution with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Equilibrate membrane in substrate buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer the membrane to a new container, add 30 mL Substrate Equilibration Buffer, and incubate 5 min with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Prepare chemiluminescent substrate
steps.instruction: Combine 2 mL Luminol/Enhancer Solution with 6 mL Stable Peroxide Solution; keep the working solution in an amber bottle and protect from light.

steps.title: Remove excess equilibration buffer
steps.instruction: Remove the membrane from the Substrate Equilibration Buffer, discard excess buffer, and place the membrane in a clean container or on a clean sheet of plastic wrap.

steps.title: Incubate membrane with substrate
steps.instruction: Pour the Chemiluminescent Substrate Working Solution onto the membrane until fully covered and incubate 5 min without shaking.

steps.title: Final membrane rinse
steps.instruction: Remove the membrane from the Working Solution, discard excess buffer, and do not allow the membrane to dry.

steps.title: Expose membrane to film
steps.instruction: Wrap the membrane in plastic wrap avoiding bubbles, place it in a film cassette, and expose to X‑ray film, adjusting exposure time or using multiple films for optimal signal.
